basis: Fictional scenario premises plus bounded analyst inference

dimensions.basis: Signed pilot charter and safety lead stop authority support bounded learning.
Retained ergonomist and two trained fit champions are allocated.
Alternatives and residual bending are documented; SOP and exclusions exist.
Task baseline, fit inventory, storage, cleaning and inspection records exist; individual checks remain required.
$18,000 trial cap, paid time, backfill, spares and maintenance reserve are allocated.
Approved station-level assessment and withdrawal/incident procedure are explicit scenario premises.
Worker representatives co-designed voluntary participation without quota increases or withdrawal penalties.
Warehouse manager, champions, maintenance and safety lead have defined ongoing duties.

go_or_no_go_scope: Supervised station-level evaluation, not production-scale rollout
